## Grids and geometry: tests and checks {#sec-ch15-ch03-tests}

This catalogue accompanies @sec-ch03. The source pin is `snapy@e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0`. No snapy
executable, installed snapy package, CUDA test or multi-rank test was run for this draft; "registered" below
describes source evidence, not a measured pass.

### Independent report checks

The command `python3 src/snapy_report/ch03/geometry_check.py` checks the closed forms of @sec-ch03 with numpy and
sympy, without importing snapy. Its committed output is `src/snapy_report/ch03/geometry_check.out`; the pytest
wrapper `src/tests/test_checks.py` runs it with every other chapter's checks.

| output label | assertion | tolerance | what it does not establish |
|---|---|---|---|
| `[C1]`-`[C3]` | radial face centroids, moment and shift; the test rationals | exact symbolic | the compiled helpers |
| `[C4]`-`[C5]` | spherical-polar averages, centroid, face-pressure and angular-momentum identities | exact symbolic | the code's area factor (@sec-ch03-sphpolar) |
| `[C6]`-`[C9]` | gnomonic angle, solid angle, lower/raise, uniform-pressure flux | $10^{-8}$ to $10^{-15}$ | the velocity source terms |
| `[C10]` | Morton order of a $4\times4$ block grid | exact | 3-D order, cubed-sphere corners |
| `[C11]` | cross-panel slide below $n_g-\tfrac12$ | exact bound | the exchange itself |

: Independent checks of @sec-ch03 and their limits. {#tbl-ch15-ch03-independent}

### Gaps

No test checks the spherical-polar $m_2$ and $m_3$ curvature sources, the synthesised $x_2$-$x_3$ ghost corners, the
face-state suffix rule on its own, the `cylindrical` type, or `DeviceTest.interpolate_LR` and
`GnomonicEquiangle.area_vol`, which print and assert nothing.
